positioning.one_liner: AI agents for hospitality: answer guest messages and calls, handle requests end to end, coordinate work across teams.
positioning.category: Hospitality AI agent platform / guest communication + ops coordination, sitting on top of PMS rather than replacing it.
positioning.current_scope: Live site is hospitality-only: STR, independent hotels, hotel groups, plus resorts, aparthotels, villas, serviced apartments. YC launch historically mentioned housing/leasing; PhocusWire still frames real-estate operations. Do not treat housing as current primary website audience.
claims_company_assertions: 300+ brands / 120+ countries on homepage vs 1000+ on YC and LinkedIn
50M+ conversations, $3B+ reservation value influenced, 87% autonomous, 95% CSAT, <1 min first reply
G2 4.7/5 (G2 page 403 during research; Stork.AI third-party cites 4.7 from 69 reviews)
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, enterprise controls; alternatives page also claims GDPR and ISO 27001

modules: Portals (guest link: guidebook, upsells, payments, ID/waivers, AI concierge)
Devices (locks/thermostats/sensors) in pricing and LinkedIn posts
iOS app; Google Play coming soon per LinkedIn

capabilities: Reply across email, WhatsApp, SMS, social, voice, connected OTAs
Act in connected PMS: bookings, payments, tasks
Performance reporting: automation rate, response time, resolution, CSAT
Smart home: August, Yale, Schlage, Kwikset, ecobee, Minut claimed on LinkedIn

integrations.caveat: Listing an integration is not evidence every customer uses it. Copy still says HostAI on Email/WhatsApp cards.

limits: Not a PMS, channel manager, or pricing engine
Operations module still Coming soon on nav despite Conduit Ops claims on alternatives pages
Booking.com and VRBO marked coming soon on integrations page while industry copy claims those channels
Agent quality depends on knowledge-base quality and SOPs
HIPAA is claimed; hospitality use-case for HIPAA is unexplained publicly

pricing.public: Per-unit starting rates: Messaging $18, Guest $30, Guest+Devices $36, Full Suite $48; credits 40/60/80/100 per unit/mo; scales beyond 50 listings. Startup 0-25 units $899/mo, 2000 credits, no implementation fee. Full Suite Talk to Sales.
pricing.not_established: Absence of list price for large portfolios is not evidence of being free or expensive. Third-party reviews citing ~$500-$649/mo appear to describe older or different packaging.

suggested_segment_distinctions.segment: Scaling STR / vacation rental PMs (core evidence density)
suggested_segment_distinctions.fit: High. Most case studies, PMS integrations, per-unit pricing, Airbnb/voice/lockouts.
suggested_segment_distinctions.typical_size: Tens to a few hundred listings (HomeHop 108, Cascadia 100, Haven 270).
suggested_segment_distinctions.buyers: Founder/CEO, Head of Guest Services/Revenue, Guest Services Manager, sometimes CTO.
suggested_segment_distinctions.urgency_triggers: Adding doors, acquisition integration, peak season, VA cost, failed chatbot, overnight coverage.

suggested_segment_distinctions.segment: Independent / boutique hotels and small hotel owners
suggested_segment_distinctions.fit: Medium-high on site; fewer deep stories. Lauderdale is the main hotel story; after-hours receptionist and Opera/Mews/Cloudbeds are the pitch.
suggested_segment_distinctions.urgency_triggers: Night coverage cost, call-center spend, investor sale/OM, desk overwhelm.

suggested_segment_distinctions.fit: High for multilingual omnichannel (Wynwood, Cosmica, Bocobay).
suggested_segment_distinctions.urgency_triggers: New countries/languages, shift handoffs, tool sprawl.

suggested_segment_distinctions.fit: Aspirational on site; enterprise security, Opera, Salesforce, loyalty/upsell pages. Independent proof of Marriott/Hilton/Fairmont as paying customers was not established.
suggested_segment_distinctions.buyers: Brand ops, digital guest experience, cluster managers.
suggested_segment_distinctions.readiness: Likely longer security/IT cycle; Operations coming soon may matter.

suggested_segment_distinctions.fit: Possible via $899/25-unit Startup plan, but independent reviews say best value 20-50+ listings; PMS-native AI may suffice.
